snippet.title: MegaChud (Megaman Fangame) FULL Game Playthrough (+Download link)
snippet.description:
Edit: itch io has taken the game down, download it on google drive and cloudmail ru instead
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xEJWU2ftvkw4_ZGzBWZVDRnzNuyfougG/view?usp=drive...

Edit again : There's a glitch for Gamemaker that you might experience shader compilation crash when trying to start the fortress level. I've uploaded another version with the shader disabled.
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1XQdrbKifUDybWGcM0FzhGH-2nInqvF_F/view?usp=sharing

Follow the latest updates here!
https://chuds.life/threads/megaman-chud-a-soyjak-chudjak-themed-mega-man-fangame.69/

https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLcVSeOiWolALl8v84J97ewdrJljTqnBWm
